verdict.rationale: Ramp documents auto-categorization of transactions with real-time bidirectional sync to major accounting systems (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct, Dynamics, etc.), eliminating manual journal entries, plus an open API/CSV export for custom workflows, backed by a broad integrations directory. Independent community evidence corroborates the product as functional and widely used for expense tracking, though no third-party review specifically validates accounting-sync accuracy end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of accounting-sync reliability/edge cases beyond vendor claims.
